% Pattern: head/inline-end. A proof command starts on the line of the end of
% the lemma, as "\end{lem} \proof". A head in bold after the end of an
% equation on its line is not an item. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1
% want head-1 proof - proves=lem-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{lem}{Lemma}
\def\proof{ { {\noindent \it Proof} \hbox{       } } }
\begin{document}
\begin{lem} Every compact space is
bounded. \end{lem} \proof Cover the space by balls. $\Box$

\begin{equation} a = b \end{equation} {\bf Theorem 2.} is what we use next.
\end{document}
